records.source:
If you kill multiple gang members (including the Saints) from a vehicle within a short period you get access to the Drive By Diversion.
Drive by and kill gang members from inside your vehicle for cash. 
Note: Only kills shot from inside your vehicle count.
records.text:
短时间内在车中击杀多名帮派成员（包括圣徒），即可开始驾车射击消遣。
在车内射杀帮派成员可以获得现金。
注意：只有从车内开枪造成的击杀才会计数。

records.source:
These commands provide useful internal information of the game for modders.

361 - Display currently active mission or activity's internal ID
362 - on_hood_changed: Show internal "Hood" name when moving into a new hood
363 - on_district_changed: Show district name when moving into a new district
364 - on_purchase: Show messages when a clothing item, a food, or a new weapon (but not ammo) is bought
365 - on_notoriety_event: Show messages when the player's notoriety gets changed by crimes or enemy gang member kills
366 - on_projectile_hit: Show messages when a non-bullet projectile (rockets or granades) hits something
367 - on_hit_ped: Show messages when a player's vehicle runs over a human
368 - on_random_human_killed: Show messages when someone kill a human (only works in missions)
371 - on_random_mover_killed: Show messages when someone kill a "mover" such as barrels or parking meters (only works in missions)
372 - on_random_vehicle_killed: Show messages when someone kill a vehicle (only works in missions)
373 - on_take_damage: Show messages when the player gets damaged
374 - on_collision: Show messages when the player's vehicle collides with something
375 - on_vehicle_stunt: Show messages when the player gets respect from a vehicle-related stunt
376 - Display current vehicle's internal type name
records.text:
这些指令为模组开发者提供游戏内部信息。
361 - 显示当前任务或活动的内部编号
362 - on_hood_changed：进入新街区时显示内部街区名
363 - on_district_changed：进入新城区时显示城区名
364 - on_purchase：购买服装、食物或新武器时显示消息（不含弹药）
365 - on_notoriety_event：犯罪或击杀敌对帮派导致恶名变化时显示消息
366 - on_projectile_hit：火箭或手雷等非子弹投射物击中目标时显示消息
367 - on_hit_ped：玩家车辆撞到人时显示消息
368 - on_random_human_killed：有人被杀时显示消息（仅任务中）
371 - on_random_mover_killed：油桶或停车计时器等可动道具被毁时显示消息（仅任务中）
372 - on_random_vehicle_killed：车辆被毁时显示消息（仅任务中）
373 - on_take_damage：玩家受伤时显示消息
374 - on_collision：玩家车辆发生碰撞时显示消息
375 - on_vehicle_stunt：玩家通过车辆特技获得尊重时显示消息
376 - 显示当前车辆的内部类型名

records.source:
Sandbox++ is a modified version of Sandbox+ included in Gentlemen of the Row mod.
It allows you to teleport to districts and cribs, or you can make Stilwater a ghost town.
Download this mod here:
https://www.saintsrowmods.com/forum/threads/16592/

To use a Sandbox++ command, you first press 888 in sequence, then enter 3 digit codes.

* Animation Command Notes: Certain animations are only loaded in certain areas. For example the pole stand (pole dance) will only work in the Red Light District and Suburbs (Techncially Legal), the inmate animations will only work at the prison, etc. You can tell if an animation is not loaded in your current area if your character does a T-pose (sticks out his arms like an airplane.)

* Outfit Command Notes: To revert the outfit, open your wardrobe in a crib. When you change your outfit then change to another one, some items of the previous outfit will remain on your character (Example: when going from Fire Suit to Video Repair, the helmet from Fire Suit will remain on Video Repair outfit)
records.text:
Sandbox++ 基于 Gentlemen of the Row 模组附带的 Sandbox+ 修改而来。
它可以传送到各个城区和据点，也能让整个城市变成空城。
模组下载地址：
https://www.saintsrowmods.com/forum/threads/16592/
使用指令时，先依次按下 888，再输入三位数指令代码。
动作指令说明：部分动作只在特定地区加载。例如钢管舞只在红灯区和郊区的 Technically Legal 夜总会可用，囚犯动作只在监狱可用。如果人物双臂平伸，摆出 T 字姿势，说明当前地区没有加载该动作。
服装指令说明：到据点衣柜换装即可恢复。连续切换指令服装时，上一套的部分物品可能残留。例如从防火服换成维修服后，防火服头盔仍可能保留。
